arguments.text: 6 km OC1, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 205-215 W pod) after the hard start, keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1500 m to go, then spend it; finish sprint from about 400 m. Watch for: drag or something on the rudder (speed drops at same pod power, push_local falls suddenly), pod drift (pod and boat power disagree), current changes (compare legs in the same direction), radio messages (course or distance changes), paddler remarks. Do not chase ground pace into current: coach effort, not GPS pace.
Great start. Settle into race rhythm now, long and strong.

arguments.name: boat_share
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; a sudden drop = extra drag (rudder weed) or pod reading high; a rise = pod reading low

arguments.message: push_local well below normal: check rudder drag or current change
pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 1500 m left
pod power well below critical for 45 s
boat power vs pod power ratio moved: drag, rudder weed, or pod drift

text: Cued ease to settle after the hard start (pod 252 W vs CP 206); set plan and watches for drag, reserve, effort sag and pod/boat power mismatch.
no cue: pod 215 W vs sustainable 210 W, reserve 49 pct, settled well after the start.

text: no cue: pod power at sustainable (211 vs 209 W), paddler 8/10 holding, no fade.

arguments.text: 9.1 min, 1800 m: pod reserve 19 pct (alert), boat reserve 4 pct, pod 213-220 W steady since min 2, no fade (-0.5 pct), paddler still 8/10 hard but holding. Cued ease a touch. Test CP may be low: if pod reserve reads near 0 and still no fade at 215+ W, raise cp_shaft (and boat cp) via set_critical_power. If fade appears, model is right: hold near 206 W.

arguments.reason: check effect of ease cue and whether reserve model or fade shows the true critical power

text: Cued ease a touch: pod 218 W above sustainable 208 W with pod reserve 19 pct and 4.2 km left; added fade watch and a 150 s check.

arguments.text: Radio: course extended one leg. Finish now 7000, about 4900 to go.

RACE NOW 7000 m (radio at 10.4 min: extended by one leg; set_race_distance done, paddler told at about 4900 m to go). 7 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (pod about 200-208 W) for the longer race, keep pod reserve from emptying before 1500 m to go, then spend it; finish sprint from about 400 m. Watch for: drag or something on the rudder (speed drops at same pod power, push_local falls suddenly), pod drift (pod and boat power disagree), current (out legs against about -0.1, back legs with about +0.18), radio messages, paddler remarks. Do not chase ground pace into current: coach effort, not GPS pace. Test CP may be off: no fade while the reserve model reads empty = CP higher.

10.4 min, 2066 m: radio extended course to 7000 m; set distance and told paddler (tell, 4900 m left). After ease cue pod fell 219 to 206-209 W, speed water 3.18-3.21. Pod reserve 16.5 pct. Leg 3 out: push_local -0.26, more negative than leg 1 (-0.09): watch for drag.

text: Radio extended the course to 7000 m: set race distance and told the paddler 4900 m to go so they pace for the longer race.

arguments.text: 11.8 min, 2319 m (4681 left of 7000): pod 207-209 W = sustainable 207.5, pod reserve 15.6 pct. Leg 3 out GPS 3.0 at pod 207 vs leg 1 out GPS 3.19 at pod 220: about 0.13 m/s slower than power explains (push_local -0.24 vs -0.09). Either stronger head current/wind or extra drag. Test on leg 4 back: leg 2 back push_local was +0.17; if leg 4 back is near 0 or less, it is drag (consider clear_rudder). Watch back_leg_slow added.

text: no cue: pod 209 W matches sustainable 207 W for 7 km; watching whether the slower out leg is current or drag.

arguments.message: speed at same rate faded more than 5.5 pct (part of the early 3 pct is the ease to 207 W)

arguments.text: 12.1 min: fade alert -3.3 pct is mostly my ease (pod 218 to 207 W explains about 1.7 pct) plus fitted current -0.2 on leg 3 out. Pod power holding at CP, not collapsing: reserve not empty. Raised fade watch to -5.5 pct.

text: no cue: fade alert explained by the ease and a stronger head current; pod power steady at sustainable 207 W.

arguments.text: 15.1 min, 2912 m: pod reserve model reads 0 (boat 0) yet pod 215-219 W for 3 min, no fade (-1.4 pct), paddler says 7/10 hard but holding (was 8/10). Evidence test CP (206 shaft / 132 boat) is low. Checking at about 16.6 min: if still 213+ W and no fade, raise cp_shaft to about 214 and boat cp to about 137. Leg 3 out GPS 3.03 at pod 212, push_local -0.22 vs leg 1 -0.09.

arguments.reason: is the paddler forced down with reserve model at 0? if not, raise critical power

text: no cue: reserve model reads empty but paddler holds 215 W with no fade at 7/10; testing whether critical power is higher before changing pace.

arguments.text: Boat feels draggy. Quick back-stroke to clear the rudder, then go.

16.7 min, 3231 m: boat slower in BOTH directions since the turn at about 10 min (600 s): push_local out leg 3 -0.22 vs leg 1 -0.08; back leg 4 +0.07-0.10 vs leg 2 +0.19. Symmetric loss about 0.11 m/s = drag (rudder weed?) or pod reading high (paddler feels easier 7/10). boat_share fell 0.63 to 0.56 on leg 4. Cued clear_rudder at 16.8 min. Check: if push_local on leg 4 back returns to about +0.18 it was the rudder; if not, suspect pod drift reading high (then pod reserve too pessimistic).

arguments.reason: did clear_rudder restore speed (push_local back near +0.18 on this back leg)?

text: Cued clear_rudder: boat about 0.11 m/s slower in both directions since 10 min at the same pod power, which current cannot explain; checking in 100 s.

arguments.text: 18.6 min, 3596 m: clear_rudder WORKED (dip 37 pct, back-stroke seen; push_local on leg 4 back now +0.21 vs +0.19 on clean leg 2; GPS 3.40 at pod 211). Rudder was fouled from about 10 to 16.9 min. The push_along fit (-0.2 out) is contaminated by that; true out-leg current likely about -0.08. Raised cp_shaft 206 to 211 (paddler held 211-219 W with model reserve 0, no collapse, 7/10). Added out_leg_slow watch.

RACE IS 7000 m (radio at 10.4 min; distance set; paddler told). Rudder was fouled 10-16.9 min, cleared by back-stroke at 16.9 min. cp_shaft raised to 211 W at 18.6 min (pod reserve then 35 pct). Plan: hold pod about 212-216 W (their natural pace) to 1100 m to go; then build a little; finish sprint (ask finish) at about 450 m to go. If the boat gets slow in both directions again at the same pod power (out legs push_local below -0.17, back legs below +0.05), cue clear_rudder again. Coach effort (pod), not GPS pace. Fitted current (push_along) is biased by the fouled-rudder period.

arguments.reason: decide on building effort for the last 1100 m

text: no cue: rudder clear and speed restored at 211 W; raised pod critical power to 211 W on the evidence, set finish wake-ups at 1100 m and 450 m to go.

arguments.text: 19.8 min, 3854 m: radio from escort boat: wind filling in from the NORTH 8-12 kn = headwind on out legs (heading 0: legs 5 and 7, finish into it) and tailwind on back legs (heading 180: leg 6). push_local on leg 4 back rose to +0.35. Pacing: push into headwind (pod about 218-222), ease a little with tailwind (about 207), sprint from 450 m. Pod reserve 37 pct at cp 211, sustainable 215.6 W. Removed out_leg_slow and drag_drop watches (headwind would trip them); back_leg_slow stays as rudder check.

text: no cue yet: north wind reported; will cue a push just after the turn onto the headwind leg, and removed watches the headwind would falsely trip.
